With the series tied 2-2 and Detroit’s advanced metrics showing a 10.2% increase in offensive efficiency since the first round, the Pistons’ front office faces a critical juncture: balancing roster retention with the financial strain of a $130M+ payroll in a luxury-tax-heavy cap situation . Meanwhile, the Pistons’ playoff push injects $42M+ in estimated local hospitality revenue , a windfall for Detroit’s premium event vendors and stadium-adjacent slight businesses .

Yet behind the scenes, General Manager Ed Stefanski confronts a dead-cap hit exceeding $15M due to expiring contracts and non-guaranteed salaries. According to the latest CBA provisions , the Pistons must navigate load management for key players like Isaiah Stewart (28.3% of minutes played) while avoiding arbitration overages that could trigger luxury-tax penalties.
